title: Exposing FRAUD And DECEPTION In The Retro Video Game Market
summary: Karl Jobst investigates the retro video game bubble, examining who caused it, who profits, and how graders and auction houses like Wata Games and Heritage inflate prices. It runs almost an hour.
why: HN points to it as investigative journalism backing the view that vintage game prices are inflated by wash trading and grading services.

quote.text: It's almost an hour long piece of effectively investigative journalism
